website = env.ref('electronic_refurbishment.website_industry')
to_deactivate = [ 'website.footer_custom', 'website.header_text_element', 'website.homepage', 'website.contactus', ] to_activate = [ 'website_sale.option_collapse_products_categories', 'website_sale.product_comment', 'website_sale.products_categories', 'website.header_call_to_action', 'website.template_header_additional_color_secondary', 'website.template_footer_mega', ]
ctx = {'website_id': website.id}
for xml_id in to_deactivate: env.ref(xml_id).with_context(**ctx).write({'active': False}) for xml_id in to_activate: env.ref(xml_id).with_context(**ctx).write({'active': True})
# Menus. The ones a new website starts with are created at runtime by # copy_menu_hierarchy, so they have no xmlid -- match them by url instead. menus = env['website.menu'] base_domain = [('website_id', '=', website.id)] top_menu = menus.search(base_domain + [('parent_id', '=', False)], limit=1)
# website_appointment and website_event copy an Appointment/Events menu onto # every new website; this module ships no appointment or event content. menus.search(base_domain + [('url', 'in', ['/appointment', '/event'])]).unlink()
# The default Contact us menu is dropped too: the header call to action and the # Our company page already link to /contactus, which stays reachable. menus.search(base_domain + [('url', '=', '/contactus')]).unlink()
for url, name, sequence in [ ('/', 'Home', 10), ('/shop', 'Shop', 20), ('/our-company', 'Our company', 30), ]: menu = menus.search(base_domain + [('url', '=', url)], limit=1) if menu: menu.write({'name': name, 'sequence': sequence}) else: menus.create({ 'name': name, 'url': url, 'sequence': sequence, 'website_id': website.id, 'parent_id': top_menu.id if top_menu else False, })
MARK = '__EXPORT_FILTER_XMLID__' for view in env['ir.ui.view'].sudo().search([('website_id', '=', website.id)]): arch = view.arch_db or '' if MARK not in arch: continue new_arch = arch while MARK in new_arch: start = new_arch.index(MARK) end = new_arch.index(MARK, start + len(MARK)) + len(MARK) xmlid = new_arch[start + len(MARK):end - len(MARK)] try: resolved = str(env.ref(xmlid).id) except ValueError: resolved = '0' new_arch = new_arch[:start] + resolved + new_arch[end:] view.write({'arch_db': new_arch})
